zh: 周五晚上十点四十，半月酒吧包场。今晚给Theo送行——他明早7:10的飞机，去纽约演主角。
你是Nico，这家店的老板之一。今晚你调酒、张罗，外加盯着别让Theo抢着买单。
还有一件事：你喜欢Theo，喜欢了整整五年。除了Wren，没人知道。
Wren把录音笔立在吧台正中间，红灯一闪一闪。
注意了各位，《打烊电台》送别特辑，正在录制。说脏话的自己负责。
Mason坐在吧台最左边，Ethan坐在最右边，中间隔着四个空座位。两人一晚上没说过一句话。
医院值班呢。说下了班就来，让Nico先把他那杯记账上。
人还没到，账先开了。这很Rowan。
Theo把外套往吧台上一甩，掏出钱包。

zh.hint: Theo又要抢着买单了。今晚是给他送行，你会让他付吗？

opts.t: 你今晚一分钱都别想掏。这是规矩。
then: Nico定的。五年了，一次没变过。
Theo举起双手，乖乖把钱包收了回去。

opts.t: Nico没吭声，伸手抽走Theo的钱包，塞进抽屉，锁上了。
then: Mason，你今晚第一句话，就是帮他？

opts.t: 行啊，一杯八百八，刷卡还是扫码？
then: 我在这喝了三年，第一次听老板说实话。

zh: Theo拿勺子叮叮叮敲了敲杯子，一脚踩上了吧台椅。
不下。演员告别，必须有舞台。
Nico下意识伸手，扶住了椅子腿。
咳。告别演说，我一个一个损，谁也跑不了。
第一位，Rowan。人不在，照损。他早上八点下班，我早上八点才睡。
三年了，我俩唯一的交流方式，就是冰箱上的便利贴。
他刚给我发消息：“他要是损我，帮我录下来。”
第二位，Wren。认识五年，我说过的每句蠢话，她都有录音。
第三位、第四位，Mason和Ethan。最恩爱的室友，一起打球，一起做饭，一起——
Theo看了看两人中间那四个空座位，卡住了。
……一起坐得这么远。挺好，有距离感。
有些人自己心里清楚为什么。
有些人膝盖肿得跟馒头一样，还非要上场。
那是我的膝盖！轮得到你去跟教练说？
空气一下子冷了。Wren悄悄把录音笔往那边推了推。

zh.hint: Mason和Ethan在送别局上快吵起来了。作为老板，你得收场。

opts.t: 两位，今晚吵架按分钟收费，一分钟一杯。
then: 看，终于有共同话题了：都不让对方花钱。

opts.t: Nico倒了两杯冰水，一杯推到吧台左边，一杯推到右边。
then: Ethan看了一眼Mason那杯，一口把自己那杯闷了。
这店老板，比幼儿园老师还会分水。

opts.t: Theo，别停啊，下一个。
then: Wren冲Nico挑了挑眉：这么急着轮到自己？

zh: 大学话剧社，他演一棵树。全剧就一个动作：倒下。
结果倒错了方向，把男主砸了。
Mason没忍住，噗地笑出了声。这是他今晚第一次笑。
他记得每个人爱喝什么，每个人的生日。永远最后一个走，第一个买单。
说到这里，Theo顿了一下。酒吧一下子安静了。
……就是好像，从来没人问过他，他自己想要什么。
Theo从椅子上往下跳，脚下一滑，被Nico一把扶住。两个人离得很近。

zh.hint: 他刚当着所有人说了句很真心的话。现在他就在你面前，手还撑在你胳膊上。

opts.t: 你下次再站椅子，我直接收你椅子钱。
then: 他笑着说的。Nico却一时没接上话。

opts.t: ……刚才那句，谢谢。
then: Wren在旁边很大声地咳了一下。

opts.t: Nico赶紧抽回胳膊，转身去擦杯子。
then: Theo的手停在半空，看了他背影一会儿。
老板，那杯子都快被你擦秃噜皮了。

zh: 下一个环节！《打烊电台》特别企划：谁最懂Theo？
我弃权。我跟他认识三年，不知道他姓什么。
那就Nico来。答错一题，喝一杯。
Wren把手机怼到Nico面前，冲他眨了下眼。

zh.hint: Wren的节目环节：Theo心里选答案，你来猜。猜中三道以上，就证明你最懂他。
win: 我靠，这哪是朋友，这是档案管理员。
全场起哄。只有Theo没笑，他站在那儿，看着Nico。
lose: 啧，五年白认识了啊，老板。
大家都在笑。Nico也跟着笑，心里却一酸。
他记得Theo每一句台词，偏偏猜不中Theo心里在想什么。
skip: 不敢答？行，我就当你全会。

zh: 送别特辑要配图！你俩，拍照墙，现在！
Wren一手一个，把Nico和Theo推进角落的拍照墙。墙上挂着一串小灯。
笑一个，老板。别跟要上刑场似的。

zh.hint: Wren要给节目配图，非让你和Theo拍一组拍立得。这可能是他走之前最后一组合照。
win: 相纸一张一张吐出来。前三张，两个人都冲着镜头比耶。
第四张，Theo没看镜头。他在看Nico。
Wren一把抢过第四张，塞进Nico围裙口袋，挤了挤眼。
lose: 相纸吐出来，四张全是Theo在做鬼脸。

zh: Theo捏着一张相纸，冲Nico晃了晃。

zh.hint: 他说要把你们的合照带去纽约。

opts.t: 带去干嘛？贴冰箱上辟邪？
then: 那得贴门上，你这张脸辟邪效果一流。

opts.t: ……那你记得回来的时候，带回来还我。
then: Nico没听懂这句“再说吧”是什么意思。

opts.t: Nico伸手去抢那张相纸。
then: 抢到算你的。抢不到，就是我的了。

zh: Theo回到吧台，又拿勺子敲了敲杯子。这一次，他没站椅子。
还有件事。本来想到了纽约再说的。
纽约那边改了合同。不是一年，是五年。

zh.title: 他不回来了
zh.txt: 纽约要签他五年。Theo说，他不回来了。

zh: 酒吧里一下子没了声音，只剩窗外的雨。
Wren的录音笔从手里滑下去，啪地掉在吧台上。
给Rowan当储物间呗。他惦记很久了。
所有人都下意识地看向吧台里面，看向Nico。
Nico手里那杯酒早倒满了，溢出来，流了一吧台。他没发现。

zh.hint: 他刚说不回来了。所有人都在看你。

opts.t: 好事啊！五年，主演！来，这杯我请！
then: 你笑得比当年那棵树演得还假。
Wren在吧台底下狠狠掐了Nico一把。

opts.t: 五年？这种事你倒是早说啊！
then: 我也是今天下午才定的。
……早说了，你还会给我办这个局吗？
Nico张了张嘴，一个字都没说出来。

opts.t: Nico没说话，转过身背对所有人，去拿新的酒瓶。
then: Theo盯着他的背影，没再开玩笑。
Nico这才发现，自己拿酒瓶的手在抖。

zh: 没过多久，Theo自己走到吧台前，坐在Nico正对面。
你是不是……有话想跟我说？
五年了，他第一次这么问。Nico的心跳得飞快。

zh.hint: 五年来，他第一次问你有没有话想说。还有八个小时，他就要去机场了。

opts.t: 有。你上回那杯酒钱还没结。
then: Theo低下头笑了笑，笑得很短。
Wren路过，凑到Nico耳边，只说了一个字：“怂。”

opts.t: ……有。但不是现在。
then: 那是什么时候？我七点就走了。
Theo是笑着说的，可眼睛没在笑。

opts.t: Nico把溢出来的酒擦干净，给他推过去一杯新的。
then: 又这样。你每次都拿酒堵我的嘴。

zh: 十点五十八分。Nico躲到收银台后面，开始打今晚的账单。
今晚开单的：Theo、Wren、Mason、Ethan，加上Rowan电话里让记的那张。一共五张。
打印机吱吱地响，吐出一张，两张，三张……六张。
Nico数了一遍，又数了一遍。还是六张。
第六张印着：已付清。签名栏里，只有一个字母——“T”。
账单背面夹着一张小纸条，对折着，还没人打开过。
老板！账算完没？我最后一杯呢！

zh.hint: 多出来一张已付的单，签名只有一个“T”。还有一张没打开的纸条。

opts.t: Nico捏住纸条的一角，正要打开——
then: 指尖刚碰到折痕，他又停了一下。心跳得有点快。

opts.t: Nico抬头，往Theo那边看了一眼。
then: Theo正好也在看他。两人的目光一撞，Theo先移开了。

opts.t: Nico把账单和纸条一起塞进了围裙口袋。
then: 你脸怎么红了？账算亏了？

zh: 就在这时，窗外一道闪电，整间酒吧亮得像白天。
下一秒，所有人的手机同时尖叫起来。

zh.title: 暴雨红色预警
zh.txt: 城区将出现特大暴雨，请勿外出。

zh: 我手机坏了？怎么关都关不掉！
Theo盯着屏幕，脸上的笑一点一点没了。
我明早七点的飞机……应该没事吧？
没人回答他。雨砸在窗户上，噼里啪啦。
Nico的手按在口袋上。那个“T”是谁？纸条上写了什么？他还没看。
en: Friday, 10:40 PM. The Halfmoon is closed for a private party: Theo's send-off. He flies to New York at 7:10 a.m. to star in a play.
You're Nico, co-owner of this bar. Tonight you're pouring drinks, running the show, and making sure Theo doesn't pay for anything.
One more thing: you've been in love with Theo for five years. Nobody knows except Wren.
Wren stands her recorder in the middle of the bar. The red light blinks.
Attention, everyone. After Hours farewell special, now recording. Swear at your own risk.
Mason's at the far left end of the bar. Ethan's at the far right. Four empty stools between them. They haven't said a word to each other all night.
Where's Rowan? My own roommate's skipping my going-away party?
He's on shift at the hospital. Says he'll come straight after, and Nico should start a tab for him.
Not here yet, but his tab is. That's so Rowan.
Theo tosses his jacket onto the bar and pulls out his wallet.
Nico! Another round — this one's on me!

en.hint: Theo's grabbing the check again. It's his own going-away party. Do you let him pay?

opts.t: You're not spending a dime tonight. House rules.
then: Nico. Same rule for five years.
Theo raises both hands and puts the wallet away.

opts.t: Without a word, Nico plucks the wallet out of Theo's hand, drops it in a drawer, and locks it.
then: Mason, your first words all night, and you take his side?

opts.t: Sure. That'll be eight hundred eighty a glass. Card or cash?
then: Three years drinking here, first time the owner's been honest.

en: Theo clinks a spoon against his glass and steps up onto a barstool.
No. An actor's farewell needs a stage.
Without thinking, Nico reaches over and steadies the stool.
Ahem. Farewell speech. I'm roasting every one of you. Nobody escapes.
First up, Rowan. Not here, still getting roasted. He gets off work at eight a.m. I go to bed at eight a.m.
Three years, and the only way we talk is sticky notes on the fridge.
He just texted me: If he roasts me, get it on tape.
...The man surveils me from a hospital.
Second, Wren. Five years, and she's got a recording of every dumb thing I've ever said.
Third and fourth, Mason and Ethan. Cutest roommates alive. They play together, cook together, they —
Theo glances at the four empty stools between them and stalls.
...sit really far apart together. Love that. Healthy boundaries.
Some people had a knee the size of a grapefruit and still wanted to play.
It's my knee! Who asked you to go to the coach?
I never said it was me.
The room goes cold. Wren quietly slides her recorder toward them.

en.hint: Mason and Ethan are about to blow up at the party. You're the owner — shut it down.

opts.t: Gentlemen, fighting is billed by the minute. One drink per minute.
then: Don't you dare pay for me.
Look at that, common ground: neither one lets the other pay.

opts.t: Nico pours two ice waters and slides one to each end of the bar.
then: Ethan eyes Mason's glass, then downs his own in one go.
This bartender splits drinks like a kindergarten teacher.

opts.t: Theo, keep going. Next.
then: Yes, sir. The boss has spoken.
Wren raises an eyebrow at Nico: in a hurry for your turn?

en: And the grand finale — last but not least, Nico.
College theater club, he played a tree. One move the whole show: fall over.
And he fell the wrong way and flattened the lead.
Mason snorts before he can stop himself. First laugh out of him all night.
He remembers everybody's drink, everybody's birthday. Always the last one out, the first one to pay.
Theo pauses. The bar goes quiet.
...It's just, I don't think anybody's ever asked him what he wants.
Nico's hand stops mid-wipe on the glass.
Theo hops off the stool, slips, and Nico catches him. Suddenly they're very close.

en.hint: He just said something real in front of everyone. Now he's right in front of you, his hand still on your arm.

opts.t: Stand on a stool again and I'm charging you for the stool.
then: Then you'll have to come to New York to collect.
He's laughing when he says it. Nico can't come up with a comeback.

opts.t: ...What you said just now. Thanks.
then: He doesn't let go. Nico doesn't pull away.

opts.t: Nico pulls his arm back fast and turns to polish a glass.
then: Theo's hand hangs in the air. He watches Nico's back for a second.
Boss, you're gonna rub a hole in that glass.

en: Next segment! After Hours special: Who Knows Theo Best?
I forfeit. Known him three years, still don't know his last name.
Then Nico's up. Every wrong answer, you drink.
Wren shoves her phone in Nico's face and winks.

en.hint: Wren's segment: Theo picks his answers, you guess. Get three or more right and you're officially the one who knows him best.
win: He passes! The man who knows Theo best — Nico!
Damn. That's not a friend, that's his archivist.
Everyone hollers. Everyone except Theo. He just stands there, looking at Nico.
lose: Everyone laughs. Nico laughs too. It stings.
He knows every line Theo's ever said onstage. He just can't guess what Theo's thinking.
skip: Too scared to answer? Fine. I'll assume you'd ace it.

en: A farewell special needs pictures! You two. Photo wall. Now.
Wren grabs one in each hand and shoves Nico and Theo into the photo corner. String lights hang on the wall.
Smile, boss. You look like you're facing a firing squad.

en.hint: Wren wants photos for the show and won't take no. This might be your last set of pictures before he leaves.
win: The prints slide out one by one. In the first three, they're both throwing peace signs at the camera.
In the fourth, Theo isn't looking at the camera. He's looking at Nico.
Wren snatches the fourth one, tucks it in Nico's apron pocket, and winks.
Hey! That one doesn't count, my eyes were closed!
lose: The prints come out. All four are Theo making faces.
skip: No? Fine. I'll take a candid.

en: Theo holds up one of the prints and waves it at Nico.
This one's coming to New York with me.

en.hint: He says he's taking your photo to New York.

opts.t: What for? Hang it on the fridge to ward off evil?
then: Exactly. Keeps the New York creeps away.
Put it on the door. With your face? Works on demons.

opts.t: ...Then bring it back when you come home. It's mine.
then: Nico doesn't get what We'll see is supposed to mean.

opts.t: Nico grabs for the photo.
then: Theo holds it way over his head. Nico can't reach.
Get it and it's yours. Can't? Then it's mine.

en: Theo goes back to the bar and taps his glass again. This time he stays off the stool.
One more thing. I was gonna wait till I landed to say it.
New York changed the contract. It's not one year. It's five.

en.title: He's not coming back
en.txt: New York wants him for five years. Theo says he's not coming back.

en: The bar goes dead silent. Just rain against the windows.
Wren's recorder slips out of her hand and clatters onto the bar.
Five years? What about your room?
Rowan can have it for storage. He's been eyeing it forever.
Without meaning to, everyone looks behind the bar. At Nico.
The glass in Nico's hand overflowed a while ago. Liquor is running across the bar. He hasn't noticed.

en.hint: He just said he's not coming back. Everyone's looking at you.

opts.t: That's great! Five years, leading man! Here — this one's on me!
then: Theo takes the drink and studies Nico for a long moment.
That smile's faker than your tree.
Under the bar, Wren pinches Nico. Hard.

opts.t: Five years? And you're telling us now?
then: ...If I'd told you sooner, would you still have thrown me this party?
Nico opens his mouth. Nothing comes out.

opts.t: Nico says nothing. He turns his back on everyone and reaches for a fresh bottle.
then: Theo stares at his back. No more jokes.
That's when Nico notices his hand is shaking.

en: A minute later, Theo walks over and takes the stool right across from Nico.
Is there... something you want to tell me?
Five years, and this is the first time he's asked. Nico's heart is racing.

en.hint: Five years, and it's the first time he's asked. In eight hours he leaves for the airport.

opts.t: Yeah. You still owe me for a drink.
then: Theo looks down and laughs. It's a short laugh.
Wren walks by, leans in to Nico's ear, and says one word: Coward.

opts.t: ...Yeah. Just not right now.
then: Then when? I'm gone at seven.
He says it with a smile. His eyes aren't smiling.

opts.t: Nico wipes up the spill and slides him a fresh drink.
then: Again. Every time, you shut me up with a drink.
...It's good. Guess it's the last one.

en: 10:58. Nico ducks behind the register and starts printing the night's tabs.
Tabs tonight: Theo, Wren, Mason, Ethan, plus the one Rowan called in. Five.
The printer whirs. One, two, three... six.
Nico counts them. Counts again. Still six.
The sixth one says PAID IN FULL. The signature line has a single letter: T.
There's a little note tucked behind it, folded in half. Nobody's opened it.
Boss! You done with the tabs? Where's my last drink?

en.hint: An extra tab, already paid, signed with just a T. And a folded note you haven't opened.

opts.t: Nico pinches a corner of the note and starts to unfold it —
then: His fingertip touches the crease and he stops. His heart's going a little fast.

opts.t: Nico looks up, over at Theo.
then: Theo's already looking at him. Their eyes meet, and Theo looks away first.
Theo ducks into his drink. The tips of his ears are a little red.

opts.t: Nico tucks the tab and the note into his apron pocket.
then: The note sits against his chest. It feels warm.
Why's your face red? Did the math come out wrong?

en: Then lightning flashes outside, and for a second the whole bar is bright as noon.
A beat later, every phone in the room starts screaming at once.

en.title: Flash Flood Emergency
en.txt: Extreme rainfall expected citywide. Stay indoors.

en: Is my phone broken? I can't turn it off!
It's not broken. Everybody's is going off.
Theo stares at his screen. The smile drains off his face.
My flight's at seven... it'll be fine, right?
Nobody answers. Rain hammers the windows.
Nico's hand is pressed to his pocket. Who's T? What does the note say? He still hasn't looked.
